<function name="ApplyAddons" parent="steamworks" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Refreshes clients addons.</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Subscribes to gm_construct_beta and reloads addons.</description>
	<code>
steamworks.Subscribe( 21197 )
steamworks.ApplyAddons()
	</code>

</example>
